title: Experience Letter
description: Letter from an employer confirming someone's job title, dates and duties.
body: This is to certify that {employee_name} worked at {company_name} as {job_title} from {start_date} to {end_date}.
During this period, {employee_name} was responsible for the following: {duties}
We found {employee_name} to be dependable and professional, and we wish them every success in the future.
